description: JavaScript plugin code for TinyMCE's Search/Replace functionality, defining plugin info, initialization, control HTML, and command execution.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns plugin information such as name, author, URL, and version.

methods.name: initInstance
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with a given editor instance, adding keyboard shortcuts.

methods.name: getControlHTML
methods.description: Provides HTML for plugin controls like search and replace buttons.

methods.name: execCommand
methods.description: Executes search or replace commands within the editor, handling UI interactions and text replacement.
